activities.anchor: is a warm, oxygen-free fermentation vat
activities.caption: size the bioreactor before the tour does
activities.name: vtRumenEst

config.prompt: The rumen — largest of the cow's four forestomach compartments — holds on the order of how many litres?
config.why: On the order of 100 litres, where billions of microbes digest the cellulose no vertebrate enzyme can break — and the host then digests the microbes, harvesting their protein as they flow onward.
config.context: A starchy overload ferments to acid and collapses the whole ecosystem — rumen acidosis is a veterinary emergency that is, at root, ecological.

activities.anchor: The horse solves the same problem from the other end
activities.caption: anatomy is strategy — pair each design with its consequence
activities.name: vtGutMatch

config.prompt: Match each design to what it buys and costs:

pairs.right: microbes ferment before the small intestine; the host harvests their protein
fermentation after the small intestine, in an enlarged caecum and colon — less microbial protein, and colic as the equine emergency
hypsodont — long-crowned, continuously erupting for years of grazing abrasive grass
shearing carnassials for a carnivore's job

config.why: One gut-to-mouth tour and the lesson is permanent: anatomy is strategy, read aloud.

activities.caption: true or false — the rabbit file
activities.name: vtRabJudge

statements.why: A different order entirely — distinguished by a second pair of small upper incisors behind the front pair.

statements.s: Rabbit teeth grow continuously throughout life.
statements.why: A diet without enough grinding fibre becomes dental disease — among the most common presentations in rabbit practice, and one a 'giant gerbil' framing would miss.

statements.s: The rabbit/rodent distinction is pedantry with no clinical use.
statements.why: The distinction is clinical: continuous tooth growth makes diet a treatment, not a detail.

activities.caption: bellows vs through-flow — file each feature
activities.name: vtLungSort

config.prompt: Two respiratory designs — file each feature:

items.label: air rushes in and mostly back out the way it came
air moves one direction across the gas-exchange surfaces during both inhalation and exhalation
air sacs act as the bellows while blood flows counter to the airflow
gas exchange efficient enough to power flight at altitudes where mammals fail
no diaphragm — breathing via rib movement, air sacs extending into the bones

config.why: Handling and anaesthesia respect a completely different respiratory mechanic — the clinical edge of the design.

activities.anchor: Some differences hide in biochemistry rather than shape
activities.caption: fill the obligate carnivore's dependency
activities.name: vtTauCloze

config.text: Feed a cat a dog's diet long enough and %%0%% lack produces %%1%% and retinal degeneration, both reversible if caught — biochemical dependencies invisible on a physical exam, which is why diet history is a clinical investigation.
config.hint: The cat lost the machinery to synthesise an amino-acid-like compound abundant in animal tissue.

activities.caption: same grams, three patients — walk the dosing desk
activities.name: vtDoseBranch

config.root: A parrot, a ferret and a tortoise sit on the same scale reading. Walk the logic.

start.text: The weights are identical. Is the dose?

choices.label: Yes — mg per kg is mg per kg
choices.feedback: Metabolic rate differences mean weight-normalised doses fail in birds and reptiles in both directions.

choices.label: No — the safe amount tracks the metabolic rate, not the grams
choices.feedback: The scaling laws give the experienced clinician a prior before pharmacology gives the precise answer.

right.text: Next problem: the formulary has no entry for this species.

choices.label: Check the species before the drug
choices.feedback: A formulary is organised by species before it is organised by drug.

choices.label: Divide the dog dose by the weight ratio
choices.feedback: Scaled human-style arithmetic is exactly what fails here — distrust any number unchecked against the species at hand.

wrong.text: Species-level chemistry is not a dose subtlety — three same-weight patients are differently engineered, and grams carry less meaning than rates.

end2.text: Extralabel use under legal frameworks, withdrawal periods in food animals — the regulatory layer exists because the chemistry is species-level.

config.why: The safest reflex in comparative pharmacology is distrust of any number that has not been checked against the species at hand.

activities.caption: the herd lens — pair each concept with its logic
activities.name: vtPopMatch

config.prompt: Match each concept to what it does:

pairs.right: infection control at herd scale — quarantine, traffic control, disinfection, all-in/all-out stocking
a vaccine protecting 80 percent of individuals can extinguish transmission well before everyone is immune — the pathogen cannot find its next host
feline panleukopenia and canine parvovirus are different viruses
they cross species boundaries — and are the ones that reshape industries

config.why: Veterinary campaigns count protected populations, not protected animals — a contagious cow matters as an epidemic.

activities.anchor: every parasite has a chain of stages and hosts
activities.caption: one line of the parasite brief is wrong — click it
activities.name: vtWormSpot

config.prompt: One line of this parasite brief is wrong — click it:
lines: The dog heartworm is transmitted only by mosquitoes — prevention beats treating adult worms lodged in the heart and pulmonary arteries.
The sheep liver fluke must pass through a mud snail — drainage and grazing management of wet pastures break the chain at that host.
Coccidia in poultry complete their cycle in the litter of the house — rotation and litter management are production engineering.
Rational deworming means treating on the calendar, so every animal is covered evenly.
Refugia — deliberately leaving some worms unexposed — slows anthelmintic resistance.
config.correction: Rational deworming treats based on faecal egg counts and cycle stage — calendar dosing is exactly what the parasites evolved around.
config.why: Targeted selective treatment is applied evolution as herd management — the profession's answer to anthelmintic resistance.
